# Spreadsheets

Download the goals as an Excel workbook or CSV files, and load changes back from a spreadsheet, with every change shown before it’s saved.

Module id `spreadsheets`, in [src/modules/spreadsheets/](../../../src/modules/spreadsheets/module.json).

## What it adds to the core

| Extension point | What |
|---|---|
| Needs | none |
| Routes | `/data/import`, `/data/import/check`, `/data/import/check/changes`, `/data/import/done/:importId`, `/data/imports` |
| Old addresses | `/import` → `/data/import` |

| Outside its folder | none |

## Requirements

- `EXPORT`: Export is one sheet with one button, Export .xlsx: one Excel workbook with every sheet (a Start here sheet that says what each column means and which a new row must have, then Goals, Plan, Check-ins, People, Results, Asks, Notes and Metrics). Under Other formats: the same sheets as zipped CSVs, one sheet as a CSV, JSON with a stated format and each goal’s plan and check-ins, and a Markdown brief for AI chats. Everything in the cycle, or just the current view. The file’s name says what it holds (workspace, what, all or the view or as-shown, date) and is shown before saving. Exports agree with the screens. Rebuild: copy.
- `BULK-IMPORT`: A workbook, a zip of CSVs or one CSV can add or change people, goals, plan numbers and check-ins, including past weeks. Every row is checked with the app’s own rules and previewed before saving; nothing saves while a row needs fixing. Owners change their own goals, admins any, and admins add and change people. Past weeks are marked as loaded later and dated in their own week. Each change is logged on its goal as coming from a spreadsheet. Rebuild: copy.
- `IMPORT-ACTIONS`: A spreadsheet’s Action column stops a goal with check-ins (with a Reason) or deletes one with none, and marks someone as left (their goals, open asks and teams going to Takes over, by email), with the same rules, refusals and consequences as the app (domain/removal), shown in the preview. The import’s Undo puts every one back: the goal live again, the deleted goal restored, the person back with their goals, asks, reviews and teams. Rebuild: copy. Tests: `evals/format.eval.ts`.
- `SPREADSHEETS-ON-DATA`: Spreadsheets live on Data: Export saves the open table as laid out (.xlsx or .csv, saying how many rows and columns and which key columns are added so it loads back) or opens Everything…, the one Export; Import, beside it, opens /data/import, which offers the template (a Start here sheet, then the columns a person fills in on Goals, Plan, Check-ins and People, required headers in bold, and example rows that are never imported) and shows every change before saving. Goals keeps only a quiet Export these goals; set-up keeps its own upload; old /import links lead to Data’s Import. It is the spreadsheets module (src/modules/spreadsheets). Rebuild: copy. Tests: `evals/modules.eval.ts`.
- `FIELD-TABLE`: Every column a person can fill in says whether a new row must have it, its format, an example and what an empty cell means, in one list that the template, the workbook’s first sheet, Help, the import’s preview and the goal form are made from. Rebuild: copy. Tests: `src/domain/fieldTable.test.ts`.
- `IMPORT-LEVELS`: Every problem an import finds is Must fix, Check or fine. Must fix blocks saving; a Check is a question that must be answered; a problem is said once per kind with its count, and one answer covers every row with the same question. A near miss is asked about, never guessed and never silently refused. Rebuild: copy. Tests: `src/domain/problemLevels.test.ts`, `evals/format.eval.ts`.
- `IMPORT-PREVIEW`: Before anything is saved an import says which sheets and columns it read and which it did not, then counts by sheet, then what must be fixed, then its questions, then the changes on request with before and after and every default it used. Saving is all or nothing unless the person chooses to leave named rows out. Rebuild: copy. Tests: `src/domain/importPreview.test.ts`, `src/domain/roundtrip.test.ts`.
- `IMPORT-UNDO`: Every import, bulk edit and bulk change through MCP is one line in Past imports and one entry in Activity, and can be undone as a whole by whoever made it or an admin. Undo says beforehand which rows have changed since and will stay. Rebuild: copy. Tests: `evals/remove.eval.ts`.

## Help

- **Importing from a spreadsheet** (`import`): Load a workbook, a zip of CSVs or one CSV to add or change people, goals, plan numbers and check-ins, past weeks included, or to stop a goal.
- **Exporting** (`export`): One button: Export .xlsx. Zipped CSVs, one sheet as CSV, JSON and a brief for an AI chat are under Other formats.
- **Every column, and what it needs** (`columns`): For every column of Goals, Plan, Check-ins and People: whether a new row must have it, its format, an example, and what happens when it’s left empty.
- **Past imports and Undo** (`past-imports`): Every import, bulk edit and change through MCP in one list, newest first, each with who made it, how, what it changed, and Undo.
